title: Doc refresh: practical patterns, edge-case examples, and migration notes for tokens & components
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Scope: Update the public and internal component documentation pages to include pragmatic usage guidance, focused examples, explicit do/don't patterns, and migration notes for token renames and component API changes. Target components: Button variants, Form Tables, Data Tables, Chart primitives (line, bar), and shared tokens (spacing, type, color, radius). Goals: 1) Reduce common implementation mistakes by providing clear, copy-paste examples and anti-patterns; 2) Surface migration paths for teams upgrading from tokens v1 -> v2 and component API changes introduced in runtime-1.18; 3) Make docs consumable for both frontend engineers and product designers with a single source of truth.
acceptance_criteria: Each target component page has a concise Usage header + 3 pragmatic examples (basic, responsive, edge-case)
A Do / Don't snippet block exists for every component with visual and code examples
Migration notes include a token mapping table and a deprecation schedule with a one-month grace period
Props/API tables are generated from Storybook MDX or component TS types and validated by ENG
Documentation changes published behind a Docs feature flag and smoke-tested in staging docs site

design_decisions: Prefer minimal, copy-paste-first examples over long narratives to reduce cognitive load
Include accessibility callouts for interactive components (focus order, aria attributes) next to examples
Show both code and rendered result for every Do/Don't to make regressions obvious
Defer live sandboxes for charts until Storybook metadata exporter is complete (ENG-2199)
tradeoffs: Tradeoff: Creating more examples increases maintenance cost. Mitigation: add a docs-lint rule to flag stale examples and schedule quarterly review
Tradeoff: Auto-generated prop tables are faster but hide usage intent. Mitigation: weave short human-written notes above generated tables
risks: If ENG doesn’t finish the MDX prop exporter, prop tables will be manual and risk drift
Token migration may cause visual regressions in large downstream apps; need a migration checklist and CI visual tests
